skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts of corporate finance, including valuation, risk management, and financial decision-making.
Develop skills in financial modeling to value companies and measure risk.
Analyze financial statements and metrics to assess company value and health.
Understand the impact of taxes on corporate finance decisions.
Understand the relationship between capital structure, cost of capital, and company value.
Manage financial risks associated with company operations and market conditions.
Make informed financial decisions based on valuation and risk analysis.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to complete financial analysis projects.
Develop independent learning and self-management skills.
Apply critical thinking to financial problems and scenarios.
